energetic cycles

Mapping Your Energetic Cycles

Linear productivity is an exhausting myth invented by the modern matrix. You're forced to perform relentlessly, to maintain a permanent level of expansion behind your screens, in total disregard of your biological rhythms and your inner ecology. It's a destructive illusion that saturates your nervous system and pulls you away from your true nature.

For years, I too believed in this forced cadence, until my own collapses and the painful crossing through the ego's illusions broke it all apart. In that stripping-away, I discovered that human energy is not a straight line, but a sacred flow of successive waves: necessary times of contraction and moments of natural expansion.

Fighting these cycles exhausts you. Learning to listen to them brings back true enthusiasm — that original sense of being fully inhabited by the Divine.

a 21-day journey

A path back to your Center

Daily micro check-up exercises and heart-listening guidance, far from cold performance tools.

01

Awaken the Witness

Sit facing the switched-off screen, observe the impulse, and settle into the still space just behind the mind's agitation.

02

Welcome contraction and the Shadow

Stop feeling guilty about compulsive apps or fatigue, treating them instead as sacred guests come to purify your intention.

03

Grounding and clarity

Place your feet on the ground to break the electric scattering of the digital cloud and find peace amid the storm of notifications.

04

The final unification

Embrace light and fatigue as two complementary expressions of one and the same Consciousness.

observe without judging

Stop enduring your moods. Learn to observe your fluctuations without judging them, to become the stable witness, aligned and inhabited by the pure joy of your being.
